title: Proportional years-deprived restitution model
purpose: Separate complete-life reference from restitution for actual duration of deprivation

formula.vsl_source: HHS 2024 central regulatory value of a statistical life
formula.reference_years_status: user-chosen 100-year normalization; NOT historical life expectancy nor a factual estimate of lifespan

snapshot_sensitivity_1832.source: Cambridge HSUS Bb209–214 estimated enslaved population for 1832
snapshot_sensitivity_1832.status: hypothetical cross-sectional scenario; cannot establish actual cumulative person-years from one population snapshot
snapshot_sensitivity_1832.caution: Do not interpret each person in stock as a unique person exposed exactly ten years or sum annual population stocks as independent people

accounts.reason: No individual start/end records, lifespan normalization is normative, no statutory basis or attributed payer yet.

guards: Do not count entire life-value for partial time unless full deprivation is separately established
Avoid pretending a 100-year life is the 1832 historical average
Do not use 1832 stock as sum of all people enslaved between 1832 and 1865
Duration proportional model does not capture severity, forced labor earnings, bodily injury, family separation, descendants, mortality or land rights by itself
Any additional claim must be causally sourced and checked for double counting
Keep modern-dollar VSL-based model distinct from 1832 nominal wages and any legally prescribed interest
Do not compound a 2024-dollar base from 1832 without rebasing and a justified accrual process
